oneLine: Popees Baby Care approves Rs 511 crore acquisition and capital expansion plan.

sources.title: Popees Baby Care Approves Rs 511 Crore Acquisition and Capital Expansion Plan

synopsis: Popees Baby Care India Ltd has announced a Rs 511.33 crore acquisition of a 99.31% stake in Popees Baby Care Products Limited (PBCPL) through a share swap arrangement. The transaction involves issuing up to 2.60 crore equity shares and 98.53 lakh convertible warrants at Rs 142.44 each. In addition to the acquisition, the board approved increasing the authorized capital from Rs 10.25 crore to Rs 47 crore and a preferential issue of securities. An Extraordinary General Meeting is scheduled for November 18, 2026, to seek shareholder approval for the business consolidation and capital expansion plan. Post-transaction, the promoter group is expected to hold a 69.63% stake in the entity.
